cohort: 2,421 children from the Avon Longitudinal Study of Parents and Children (ALSPAC)
finding: No genome-wide significant interaction was found between mode of delivery and genetic variants on intelligence, although one variant in the GRIN2A gene showed a suggestive interaction.
mod_finding: This study investigates the potential interaction between mode of delivery (cesarean section) and the genetics of intelligence in children, suggesting a possible moderating effect.
